about.t: Accounting firm specializing in public accounting in Brazzaville as well as auditing and consulting.

Founded in 2009, Exco CACOGES is an auditing and business consulting firm, member of the EXCO and Kreston Global networks. We work with numerous large Congolese and international groups, ETIs, family businesses as well as small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), in all sectors of activity.

Exco CACOGES is on a human scale, this organizational structure allows for a high level of responsiveness, genuine availability and, above all, personalized support. personalized support. With around forty professionals, including three chartered accountants, Exco CACOGES offers the guarantee of a stable firm with skills tailored to customer needs.
Our firm stands out for its demanding, high-performance approach by providing specific advice to customers through an entrepreneurial approach and understanding.
Beyond our profession, the firm’s approach is to guarantee professional ethics a commitment to proximity and independence, and the development of know-how adapted to each type of business.

The firm’s partners have over 20 years' experience in public accounting, auditing and consulting, auditing and consulting have a thorough knowledge of the national and sub-regional economic environment, providing each client with the expertise to meet their expectations.

Furthermore, in order to comply with the provisions of regulation n°08-19- UEAC-010A.CM.33 of April 8, 2019 revising the status of tax advisors preventing the simultaneous practice of statutory auditing and tax consultancy, the partners of EXCO CACOGES have created the Cabinet de Conseil Juridique et Fiscal (CCJF) in July 2019, whose corporate purpose is " the exclusive practice of tax consulting ".
The CCJF is a limited liability company with a capital of 1,000,000 FCFA registered with the RCCM of Brazzaville, and is independently managed.

Under the responsibility of a CEMAC-accredited tax consultant, CCJF’s service offering is essentially based on tax consultancy and support in matters relating to company law, labor law, social law and human resources.
